'''Nogometni klub Stupčanica Olovo''' is a professional [[Association football|football]] club, based in the town of [[Olovo]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The club currently plays in the [[First League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] and plays its home matches on the [[Danac Stadium]] in Olovo, which has a capacity of 1,500 seats."}}
